name: Cutthroat Haunt OLD
description: The pain and agony endured by Abbot Ildeben as the Gardener cut his throat lingers on in this room.
disable: DC 38 Diplomacy check to appeal to the haunt and convince it the PCs aren't the source of its pain, or DC 33 Religion to rebuke the haunt in Cayden Cailean's name.

generalAbilities.name: Slash Throat
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature comes within 5 feet of the bloodstain

Effect A spectral sickle manifests behind the triggering creature, then slices around to cut at that creature's throat. The target must attempt a DC 39 Fortitude Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes 4d10 Void Damage damage.

Failure The target takes (4d10+35) Void Damage damage and is Drained 1. An eerie white scar manifests on the target's neck; this scar persists as long as the drained effect caused by this haunt lasts.

Critical Failure As failure but (4d10+70) Void Damage damage and Drained 2. The eerie white scar periodically appears to drip with blood, but this is purely an unsettling cosmetic side-effect; it does no additional damage to the victim.
